name: heart
description: A balanced heart with full lobes and a softened lower point.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: The lower silhouette is a slim V with only a slight outward convex bow. Mirrored quadratic flanks depart subtly from straight diagonals and meet a compact rounded tip. Tangents align through the side transitions and tip without inward inflections. The established upper lobes and notch are retained. Outline bounds x=3.25..20.75, y=4.1..19.9 remain centered. Review study; not owner-approved.
